questions.question: Why must a released migration never be edited?
options: Databases that already ran it would differ from new ones.
questions.explanation: A changed step would only affect new databases, so old and new copies of the schema would silently disagree. Fix with a new step.

questions.question: Which change is safe while old code is still running?
options: Changing confidence from a number to text
questions.explanation: Adding a nullable column is expand-only; old code never asks for it. The others break existing readers or writers.

questions.question: What does migrate() do on a database that is already up to date?
options: Nothing, because user_version already equals the target
questions.explanation: It starts from the stored version, so running it again is safe: it is idempotent.
